app.name: Yang Feng Enterprise
paragraph1:
Yang Feng Enterprise was established in 1987. Starting as a traditional family-run factory with a single small punch machine at home, we have expanded into a 100-ping facility equipped with multiple professional forming machines.

All molds are designed and developed in-house by professionals, eliminating the need for outsourcing. We uphold a customer-first philosophy, striving to help clients reduce costs and create greater business opportunities.

We focus on craftsmanship and quality, combining the skills of masters with over 30 years of experience and our in-house equipment to deliver high production efficiency and product quality. Over the years, we have built long-term and stable relationships with renowned domestic and international companies, exporting products worldwide, including to Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

As a company pursuing excellence, our team is dynamic and creative, always ready to tackle new challenges and provide customized solutions for our clients.

Looking ahead, we will continue expanding into international markets and give back to society with higher standards and better service, striving to become a leader in the industry. Thank you for your support and trust in Yang Feng Enterprise.
